title: Sorella, cosa dici?
subtitle: Fiordiligi and Dorabella: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 2, recitative after No. 19
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: Fiordiligi's suo vero dritto (the libretto has verso) and fa un po without apostrophes; Dorabella's sàpran with the print's accent, della malinconia (dalla), fê, intenderci (intendersi) and scieglier.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 216–218, the recitative between No. 19 and No. 20 (41 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (one reader had added a note in bar 28 to fill the bar; the judge found the bar complete as printed, with a small note for the Italian, and removed it), then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 5, 8, 9, 14, 15, 19, 25, 28, 35, 36 and 37), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. It ends at the double bar before No. 20. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 98, from Jacobs (1:40).

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
